document_metadata.summary: Paul and guards discuss Coffey's arrival; Percy's misconduct angers them. Harry gives Paul Coffey's file, warning it will horrify him, while they note Coffey's meekness despite his size.

document_metadata.title: 26、INT. E BLOCK - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Percy defiantly refuses to change his harsh approach, clashes with Paul and guards over mistreating inmates, and is ordered to clean up the restraint room after threatening behavior.

entities.name: Paul and Brutal hear Percy's yells while arriving for work
entities.description: As Paul and Brutal arrive at E Block for their shift, they pause upon hearing Percy shouting from inside the block, prompting their concern and immediate reaction.

entities.name: Inmates in the yard gather near the fence out of curiosity
entities.description: The regular inmates in the exercise yard move toward the fence to investigate the source of Percy's shouting, speculating whether a riot might be starting.

entities.name: Paul and Brutal rush into E Block after hearing commotion
entities.description: Responding to the escalating noise, Paul and Brutal break into a run and enter E Block to intervene in the unfolding disturbance caused by Percy.

entities.name: Percy searches frantically for the mouse in the restraint room
entities.description: Percy aggressively rummages through the restraint room, throwing objects into the corridor and attempting to dislodge a mouse he believes is hiding there.

entities.name: Percy attempts to move the filing cabinet to find the mouse
entities.description: In his obsessive search, Percy forcibly pushes the filing cabinet out of the restraint room, disrupting the area and creating a mess on the Mile.

entities.name: Brutal warns Percy about searching the restraint room
entities.description: Brutal calls out to Percy, informing him that they have already searched the room and found nothing, attempting to dissuade him from continuing.

entities.name: Paul stops Brutal from further confronting Percy
entities.description: Paul gives Brutal a meaningful look, silently instructing him not to challenge Percy further, choosing instead to let Percy exhaust himself in futility.

entities.name: Paul waits in amusement as Percy continues searching
entities.description: Paul leans against the desk with a smile, observing Percy's increasingly desperate and futile efforts to find the mouse, clearly entertained.

entities.name: Percy completes clearing the restraint room and finds no mouse
entities.description: After removing all contents from the restraint room, Percy reenters and surveys the empty space, stunned and disbelieving that the mouse is not present.

entities.name: Paul and the guards navigate the cluttered corridor after Percy's search
entities.description: Paul, Brutal, and Harry walk through the Mile, stepping around the scattered debris left behind by Percy's chaotic search for the mouse.

entities.name: Brutal mocks Percy's failed search with feigned disappointment
entities.description: Brutal approaches Percy and sarcastically expresses surprise that the mouse wasn't found, adding a humorous jab about the futility of the effort.

entities.summary: A corrections officer displays cruelty and insubordination, assaulting inmate Eduard Delacroix, mistreating colleagues, and fixating on killing a mouse on E Block, raising concerns about his conduct and mental state.

entities.name: Paul
entities.description: A guard at E Block who observes Percy's behavior with amusement and intervenes to prevent Brutal from confronting Percy directly.
entities.summary: A man prepares in a bathroom, another greets residents at a hospital, while a third leaves quietly with a red poncho. Later, a man hikes a ridge in a borrowed poncho eating toast, wanders a wooded path encountering a buck, and peers curiously through a grimy window.

document_metadata.title: 30、INT. E BLOCK - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Rehearsal resumes with Toot in the chair; mouse appears early, prompting Paul to restart. Team resets as witnesses arrive the next night for the actual execution.

document_metadata.title: 31、INT. BITTERBUCK'S CELL - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Bitterbuck recalls his happiest time with his young wife in the mountains; as Brutal arrives, Paul reassures him, and he prepares to face what comes next.

entities.name: Bitterbuck asks Paul about repentance and the possibility of returning to a happy time in the afterlife
entities.description: Bitterbuck, with a shaved head, quietly poses a philosophical question to Paul about whether sincere repentance could allow a person to return to their happiest moment and live there forever as a form of heaven.

entities.name: Paul lies to Bitterbuck about believing in redemption through repentance
entities.description: Paul, recognizing that Bitterbuck needs comfort rather than honesty, easily tells a lie by affirming that he almost believes in the idea of returning to a happy past life through sincere repentance.

entities.name: Bitterbuck smiles after hearing Paul's reassuring response
entities.description: After Paul affirms the idea of redemption and eternal happiness in a past joyful time, Bitterbuck responds with a smile, indicating comfort or peace with the answer.

entities.summary: A death row inmate receives an execution date, drawing morbid interest from a guard; another inmate observes a mouse, while block activity shifts due to a family visit, and a man arrives at a gathering with his daughter and family.

entities.name: Paul
entities.description: A man who listens to Bitterbuck's question about the afterlife and chooses to lie to provide comfort, despite his personal disbelief.
entities.summary: A man prepares in a bathroom, another greets residents at a hospital, while a third leaves quietly with a red poncho. Later, a man hikes a ridge in a borrowed poncho eating toast, wanders a wooded path encountering a buck, and peers curiously through a grimy window.

document_metadata.title: 61、INT. DEL'S CELL - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Paul secures Percy's compliance through a handshake deal, then helps him out of the electric chair; the scene shifts to the execution chamber the next night as witnesses arrive and a storm approaches.

entities.name: Paul retrieves injured mouse and hands it to Coffey
entities.description: Paul picks up the badly injured mouse, wincing at its condition, and silently places it into Coffey's hands through the prison cell bars.

entities.name: Coffey heals Mr. Jingles using supernatural means
entities.description: Coffey cups the dying mouse in his hands, inhales sharply, and appears to draw out a dark, insect-like substance from its body while making choking sounds, restoring the mouse to full health.

entities.name: Healed mouse revives and runs off energetically
entities.description: After being healed, Mr. Jingles bounds out of Coffey's hands, races past the guards' feet, and is joyfully gathered up by Del, who laughs and cries in relief.

entities.name: Coffey expels black insects that turn white and vanish
entities.description: Following the healing, Coffey exhales a cloud of swirling black insect-like entities from his mouth and nose, which transform into white particles and disappear into the air.

entities.name: Coffey reveals Percy's cruelty and his act of retribution
entities.description: Coffey states that Percy is bad and mean for stepping on Del's mouse, and quietly claims he 'took it back,' implying supernatural justice was enacted.

entities.name: Dean questions Coffey about the healing
entities.description: After witnessing the miraculous event, Dean turns to Coffey in stunned disbelief and whispers, 'What did you do?' seeking an explanation.

entities.name: Paul signals silence during the healing attempt
entities.description: As Coffey begins to heal the mouse, Paul gestures for quiet, halting any further questions or outbursts from the onlookers.

entities.name: Fellow prisoners and guards gather to witness the event
entities.description: Del, Harry, Dean, and other prison staff and inmates converge around Coffey's cell, watching in silence and growing awe as the healing unfolds.

entities.name: prison cell
entities.description: The confined space where Coffey is held and where the healing of Mr. Jingles takes place.

entities.name: The Green Mile
entities.description: The specific prison block within a correctional facility where the events involving Coffey and the guards occur.
entities.summary: A prison corridor on E Block, known as 'ON THE MILE,' with faded green linoleum, sixty paces long, housing death row inmates and serving as the main passage where events involving Coffey, guards, and a mouse unfold.

entities.name: Paul
entities.description: A guard on the Green Mile who retrieves the injured mouse and participates in the events surrounding Coffey's healing.
entities.summary: A man prepares in a bathroom, another greets residents at a hospital, while a third leaves quietly with a red poncho. Later, a man hikes a ridge in a borrowed poncho eating toast, wanders a wooded path encountering a buck, and peers curiously through a grimy window.

entities.name: John Coffey
entities.description: A prisoner on death row with supernatural abilities who heals the injured mouse and expels dark entities from his body.
entities.summary: A sensitive, childlike inmate on E Block, fearful of the dark and remorseful, observes a mouse and Delacroix's interactions, while another inmate reports seeing it as Percy is distracted, leading to an escape attempt.

entities.name: Delacroix
entities.description: A fellow prisoner who pleads for Coffey to save the injured mouse and later rejoices when it is healed.
entities.summary: An inmate is assaulted by Percy for smiling, another notices a mouse, which someone names Mr. Jingles and wishes to keep. On the Mile, inmates observe Paul's condition and changed appearance, with one reacting in concern after Coffey grabs him.

entities.name: Dean
entities.description: A guard on the Green Mile who witnesses the healing and questions Coffey about his actions.
entities.summary: A corrections officer assists in moving inmates, takes Delacroix to the infirmary, waxes Old Sparky, expresses concern about a mouse, fails to prevent Coffey's escape, and participates in a rehearsal involving Toot-Toot and Reverend Schuster.

entities.name: Harry
entities.description: A guard on the Green Mile who joins the others in witnessing the healing of the mouse.
entities.summary: Prison staff perform duties including inmate transfers, feeding a mouse, objecting to a medicine man's presence, executing Toot, and preparing William Wharton for execution.

entities.name: Percy
entities.description: A cruel guard on the Green Mile who steps on Del's mouse, prompting Coffey's act of retribution.
entities.summary: A corrections officer displays cruelty and insubordination, assaulting inmate Eduard Delacroix, mistreating colleagues, and fixating on killing a mouse on E Block, raising concerns about his conduct and mental state.

entities.name: Mr. Jingles
entities.description: A mouse owned by Del that is injured by Percy and later healed by Coffey using supernatural means.
entities.summary: Delacroix's pet mouse performs tricks, brings joy, and symbolizes innocence; it reacts to cornbread, escapes after Del's fall, is injured by Percy, and healed supernaturally by Coffey, drawing attention from officials and highlighting emotional bonds among inmates and guards.

entities.name: mouse
entities.description: A small rodent owned by Del, central to the healing event and symbolic of Coffey's compassion and power.

entities.name: black insects
entities.description: Supernatural entities expelled by Coffey during the healing process, which turn white and vanish.

entities.name: Paul confronts Percy about the mouse incident in the execution chamber
entities.description: Paul enters the execution chamber with Brutal and challenges Percy about his attempt to kill Mr. Jingles, expressing anger and standing up to Percy's cruelty.

entities.name: Brutal resumes polishing Old Sparky after Percy leaves the chamber
entities.description: After Percy storms out, Brutal picks up the rag Percy left behind and continues cleaning the electric chair, maintaining routine amid tension.

entities.name: Percy returns and accuses Paul and Brutal of switching the mice
entities.description: Percy reenters the execution chamber furious, accusing Paul and Brutal of deception, believing they replaced the mouse he thought he killed.

entities.name: Brutal threatens Percy by slamming him into the electric chair
entities.description: In response to Percy's outburst, Brutal physically restrains him and forces him into Old Sparky, demonstrating dominance and intimidation.

entities.description: Paul confronts Percy directly, asserting authority and demanding his word, indicating that Percy's time working with them is coming to an end.

document_metadata.title: 62、INT. DEL'S CELL - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Delacroix dies after a violent execution; Percy extinguishes the fire, Hal calms the crowd, and Paul confirms death with a stethoscope as chaos subsides.

entities.description: A pet mouse owned by Delacroix, capable of performing tricks, who becomes a symbol of innocence and emotional connection among the inmates and guards.
entities.summary: Delacroix's pet mouse performs tricks, brings joy, and symbolizes innocence; it reacts to cornbread, escapes after Del's fall, is injured by Percy, and healed supernaturally by Coffey, drawing attention from officials and highlighting emotional bonds among inmates and guards.

entities.name: Delacroix enters the execution chamber and sees Percy at Old Sparky
entities.description: Delacroix enters the execution chamber and reacts with horror upon seeing Percy already present at the electric chair, before Paul Edgecomb reassures him with a squeeze on the arm and leads him forward.

entities.description: In a series of quick shots, the execution team secures Delacroix in the electric chair by applying clamps and tightening the restraining straps.

entities.description: Percy cruelly tells Delacroix that Mouseville is not real, calling it a fairy tale invented to keep him quiet, shattering Del's hope and delivering emotional pain moments before his death.

entities.name: Delacroix delivers final words and apologizes for his crimes
entities.description: Delacroix struggles to speak, then sincerely apologizes for his actions, expresses regret, and pleads for God's mercy before his execution proceeds.

entities.description: Following Paul's nod, Harry retrieves the black mask from the back of the electric chair and pulls it down over Delacroix's head, leaving only the top of his shaved scalp exposed for the electrode.

document_metadata.title: 62、INT. DEL'S CELL - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Delacroix dies after a violent execution; Percy extinguishes the fire, Hal calms the crowd, and Paul confirms death with a stethoscope as chaos subsides.

entities.name: Percy places dry sponge on Delacroix's head during execution
entities.description: Percy deliberately uses a dry sponge, which was never dipped in water, and places it on Delacroix's head as part of the execution procedure, setting the stage for a botched electrocution.

entities.name: Electricity is activated during Delacroix's execution
entities.description: Van Hay flips the switch to begin the electrocution, sending current through Delacroix's body as per protocol, but with a dry sponge in place.

entities.name: Delacroix is electrocuted with a dry sponge causing severe burning
entities.description: Due to the absence of water in the sponge, Delacroix's body begins to burn under the electrical current, producing smoke, cracking sounds, and visible physical distress as he is effectively being cooked alive.

entities.name: Paul realizes the sponge was never soaked
entities.description: Paul observes the lack of water on the floor and around Delacroix's neck, leading him to the horrifying realization that the sponge was dry, causing the botched execution.

entities.name: Brutal stops Paul from halting the execution
entities.description: As Paul attempts to call for the execution to stop, Brutal grabs his arm and urgently warns him not to intervene, insisting it is too late to reverse the process.

entities.name: Delacroix screams in agony during electrocution
entities.description: Overcome by excruciating pain from being burned alive by the electrical current, Delacroix emits wild, animalistic screams that echo through the corridor.

entities.name: Coffey reacts to Delacroix's suffering by screaming in empathy
entities.description: Coffey, seemingly psychically attuned to the pain, begins shaking and screaming in apparent shared agony as Delacroix is being electrocuted.

entities.name: Mr. Jingles flees in terror from Delacroix's execution
entities.description: Overwhelmed by the chaos and horror of the scene, Mr. Jingles escapes Coffey's grasp and scurries toward the restraint room door in fear.

entities.name: Billy taunts the execution team during Delacroix's death
entities.description: Billy shouts from his cell, mocking the process and celebrating the gruesome outcome with phrases like 'He's cookin' now!' and 'They cookin' him good!'

entities.name: Execution Of Eduard Delacroix
entities.description: A state-sanctioned electrocution carried out at Cold Mountain Penitentiary, intended to legally execute inmate Eduard Delacroix but marred by deliberate sabotage resulting in extreme suffering.

entities.summary: A prison corridor on E Block, known as 'ON THE MILE,' with faded green linoleum, sixty paces long, housing death row inmates and serving as the main passage where events involving Coffey, guards, and a mouse unfold.

entities.description: A room adjacent to the execution chamber where inmates are restrained before execution, referenced by Mr. Jingles fleeing toward its door.

document_metadata.title: 62、INT. DEL'S CELL - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Delacroix dies after a violent execution; Percy extinguishes the fire, Hal calms the crowd, and Paul confirms death with a stethoscope as chaos subsides.

document_metadata.title: 86、INT. E BLOCK - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Paul experiences Wild Bill's violent murder of the Detterick family, witnessing how he exploited the girls' love to silence them, leaving Paul traumatized and Coffey mourning the world's cruelty.

entities.name: Dean expresses relief upon seeing Paul and the others return
entities.description: Dean reacts with visible relief when Paul, Brutal, and Coffey return to the block, exclaiming how glad he is to see them after their prolonged absence.

entities.name: Coffey is helped into his cell by the guards
entities.description: Dean assists Paul and Brutal in guiding the visibly suffering John Coffey into his cell and onto his bunk, where he sits heavily and lowers his head in pain.

entities.name: Coffey sits on his bunk and shows signs of physical distress
entities.description: After being guided to his cell, John Coffey lowers himself onto his bunk and exhibits labored breathing, indicating severe physical and emotional pain.

entities.name: Paul confirms the healing of Mrs. Moores as a miracle
entities.description: In response to Dean's question, Paul affirms that the recovery of Mrs. Moores was indeed a miracle, similar to the earlier healing of the mouse, sparking quiet celebration among the guards.

entities.name: Guards share a moment of quiet triumph after Coffey's healing
entities.description: Following Paul's confirmation of the miracle, the guards exchange knowing smiles and express cautious relief, acknowledging their shared role in the successful outcome.

entities.name: Dean retrieves Percy's belongings from the restraint room
entities.description: At Paul's instruction, Dean leaves to collect Percy's holster and baton, returning shortly after with the items.

entities.name: Percy is discovered restrained and glaring in the isolation room
entities.description: After Brutal unlocks the restraint room, Percy is revealed sitting against the wall, bound in a straitjacket and with tape over his mouth, glaring at the guards.

entities.name: Paul prepares to remove the tape from Percy's mouth
entities.description: Paul crouches in front of Percy and warns him to remain calm, holding the edge of the tape over Percy's mouth and preparing to remove it.

entities.name: Paul rips the tape off Percy's mouth causing him pain
entities.description: Paul quickly pulls the tape from Percy's mouth, causing his eyes to water in pain, with Brutal making a darkly humorous comment about the method.

entities.name: Paul slaps Percy to silence his outburst
entities.description: When Percy begins shouting demands to be released, Paul strikes him hard across the face, knocking him sideways to assert control and demand silence.

entities.name: Paul threatens Percy with severe consequences
entities.description: Paul grabs Percy and delivers a stern warning, threatening to expose his cowardice during Del's execution and implying violent retaliation from inmates if he does not stay silent.

entities.name: Paul warns Percy that the incident will remain secret
entities.description: Paul tells Percy that as long as he remains quiet, the events on the Green Mile will stay hidden, emphasizing that only pride has been damaged and can be preserved.

entities.name: Brutal reinforces the code of silence among the guards
entities.description: Brutal states the principle that 'what happens on the Mile, stays on the Mile,' affirming the group's commitment to secrecy regarding Percy's humiliation and punishment.

document_metadata.title: 94、INT. E BLOCK - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Coffey is executed amid emotional tension; Paul hesitates, they share a final connection, Coffey's last thought reveals insight, and he dies peacefully, tears falling as lights burst and witnesses react.

entities.name: Coffey is led into the execution chamber amid hostile witnesses
entities.description: John Coffey is escorted into the execution chamber by Paul and Brutal, with onlookers including Klaus and Marjorie Detterick, who express intense hatred toward him.

entities.name: Marjorie Detterick verbally attacks Coffey before execution
entities.description: Marjorie Detterick, seated in the front row, mutters curses at Coffey, urging him to die slowly and calling him a 'raping babykiller,' expressing deep hatred and grief.

entities.name: Coffey expresses fear and emotional pain from the crowd's hatred
entities.description: Coffey acknowledges the intense hatred from the onlookers, describing it as feeling like bees stinging him, causing him emotional pain.

entities.name: Brutal tells Coffey to feel the guards' lack of hatred
entities.description: Brutal responds to Coffey's pain by asserting that they don't hate him and urges Coffey to feel that distinction, offering a moment of human empathy.

entities.name: Coffey is restrained in the electric chair
entities.description: Paul and Brutal turn Coffey around and sit him in the electric chair, while they and other guards secure his arms and legs with clamps.

entities.name: Dean is seen crying during the execution procedure
entities.description: Paul notices Dean crying as he stands with his back to the witnesses, visibly distressed by the unfolding events.

entities.name: Paul instructs Dean to wipe his face before standing
entities.description: Paul quietly tells Dean to wipe his face before resuming his position, prompting Dean to wipe his tears with his coat sleeve.

entities.name: Generator is activated, lighting intensifies in the chamber
entities.description: Van Hay cranks the generator, causing the lights in the chamber to flare brighter, creating an airless, dreamlike atmosphere reminiscent of Melinda's bedroom.

entities.name: Marjorie Detterick demands Coffey suffer during execution
entities.description: Marjorie shouts, hoping Coffey is in pain and demanding that he be killed twice, expressing her desire for retribution.

entities.name: Paul reads final statement to Coffey before execution
entities.description: Paul formally addresses Coffey, stating his sentence and asking if he has any final words before the execution proceeds.

entities.name: Coffey delivers final words expressing sorrow for his existence
entities.description: Coffey hesitates, then says, 'I'm sorry for what I am,' offering a cryptic but heartfelt apology before his death.

entities.name: Brutal prepares to place the execution mask over Coffey's head
entities.description: Brutal takes the black mask from its hook and moves to place it over Coffey's head to cover his face during the execution.

entities.name: Coffey pleads not to be placed in the dark before execution
entities.description: Coffey, terrified, begs Paul not to put the mask over his face, revealing his deep fear of the dark and seeking comfort in his final moments.

entities.description: Brutal places the execution mask back on Coffey and proceeds with the sponge preparation, then lowers the cap and tightens the straps as Coffey shows visible fear and whispers about heaven.

entities.description: Jack Van Hay stands ready at the switch, waiting for the official order to proceed with the execution, but the command is delayed.

entities.name: Paul struggles to give execution order and touches Coffey's hand
entities.description: Paul hesitates to speak the execution order, overwhelmed by emotion, and reaches out to hold Coffey's hand in a final moment of connection.

entities.name: Coffey transmits final thought to Paul telepathically
entities.description: In their handclasp, Coffey silently communicates his final insight to Paul: 'He kill 'em with they love. That's how it is ever' day. All over the worl'.'

entities.name: Paul gives execution order 'Roll on two'
entities.description: After receiving Coffey's final thought, Paul steps back and utters the execution order, 'Roll on two,' the hardest words he has ever spoken.

entities.name: Van Hay activates the switch, initiating electrocution
entities.description: Van Hay throws the switch, sending current through Coffey, causing his body to surge forward with splayed, jittering fingers as the electrocution begins.

entities.name: Power surge causes lights to blow out across the Mile
entities.description: As the current flows through Coffey, a surge causes lights throughout the prison block to explode, showering glass and sparks.

entities.name: Witnesses react with fear and shock during execution
entities.description: Some of the witnesses scream in terror as the execution proceeds and the lights blow out, reacting to the violent and supernatural intensity of the moment.

entities.name: Klaus Detterick bleeds from the nose during execution
entities.description: During the electrocution, a thin line of blood trickles from Klaus Detterick's nose, which he absently wipes away while watching the execution.

entities.name: Coffey endures electrocution with eyes locked on Paul
entities.description: Coffey remains conscious through the initial surge, his eyes fixed on Paul's as he endures the current, riding the lightning until he finally slumps.

entities.name: Van Hay cuts the current after Coffey's death
entities.description: After Coffey slumps, indicating death, Van Hay turns off the electric current, ending the execution process.

entities.name: Coffey dies with peaceful expression and tears
entities.description: After the current stops, Coffey's face appears calm and serene, as if sleeping, with two final tears gently rolling down his cheeks.
